key_decisions: THE PLUGIN DECLARES A MODEL, NOT ITS WEIGHTS: requiredModels ['ltx-23-balanced'] and requiredDeps []. Listing the six LTX weights was tried and REVERTED - _pluginRequiredDepIds protects a plugin's deps unconditionally, so with both transformers absent it pinned the five shared support weights and MPI-258 B1 failed, the same circularity that stranded ~19GB. DO NOT RE-PROPOSE the obvious cure either: 'protect only while every dep is present' IS the fullyInstalled gate that MPI-310 proved destroys weights (5.24GB of Krea2's encoder). Both circularities are tabulated in docs/download-manager.md; the invariants are in tasks/_archived/MPI-276/research/04-bug-history-invariants.md. FlowDef has drawn this line since MPI-304 and ltx-foley draws it identically on this same tier. NO GC GUARD WAS TOUCHED, deliberately.

BOTH SLIDER RANGES ARE MPI-568'S AND CLOSED BY FABIO - denoise UI 0-1 over start sigma 0.50-0.85 default UI 0.5, prompt strength UI 0-1 over cfg 1-3 default UI 0. cfg defaults to the no-guidance end ON PURPOSE ('Most upscaling jobs do not want too much change anyway'); a plan recommendation of 3 was overruled, do not restore it.

THE SIGMA SCHEDULE IS ONE SCALING LAW, recovered from MPI-568's rung table: s * (1, 0.852941, 0.496353, 0), which reproduces 0.600/0.675/0.750/0.850 exactly. Building it inside the graph is CLOSED - MpiConvert.round defaults to true/'up', so 0.675, 0.5757, 0.3350, 0 would flatten to 1, 1, 1, 0 with no error and a plausible wrong video.

THE POSITIVE PROMPT MUST DEFAULT EMPTY. MPI-568's most expensive finding: the bench's own default prompt ('natural skin texture, freckles, sharp eyes') was ordering the artifact every downstream dial had been built to remove - the model rendered those freckles as MOLES on flat cheek skin. A suggestion belongs in the placeholder, never in the value.
constraints: MpiMath evaluates through safe_math, whose function table is the math module ONLY - min and max are builtins, so min(a,25) raises and MpiMath.doit CATCHES IT AND RETURNS 0.0. No error surfaces at the node; the float blows up in an unrelated node downstream. It cost one failed run. Use a conditional expression, (a if a<25 else 25), which safe_math supports.

VRAM HEADROOM IS 656 MB AND IT IS NOT THE APP'S TO SPEND. full73 fit only because the baseline happened to be 1003 MB; its 14721 MB graph cost plus the 2655 MB baseline measured earlier the SAME session is 17376 MB, over a 16380 MB card. nvidia-smi cannot attribute per-process VRAM on Windows (WDDM reports N/A) - use PowerShell Get-Counter '\GPU Process Memory(*)\Local Usage'.
